title: PRICE_ASK drops the priced note for a storage, capacity, data or RAM product and for a cost asked on a later line, and parse_tag leaves a listed source uncited
goal: kbfacts.PRICE_ASK matches a 'how much is <product> per user|device|month|year' price ask whose product names storage, capacity, data or RAM (OneDrive storage, Power BI Premium capacity, Sentinel data ingestion) and a multi-line question that asks the cost on a later line ('Context: Intune rollout.' then 'How much does it cost?'), while 'How much memory per device does Intune need?', 'how much data per month' and a Graph resource-unit cost still get no priced note; and kbfacts.parse_tag reads a kind-less part after a semicolon that lists several source ids before its colon (as in [CODE S-a: p#x;S-b, S-c: q#y]) as further sources of the part before it, as it reads a single id there, with lint.py and rag.py eval clean

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts as k;pos=['How much is OneDrive storage per user per month?','How much is the Power BI Premium capacity per month?','How much is Microsoft Sentinel data ingestion per month?','Context: Intune rollout.\nHow much does it cost?'];neg=['How much memory per device does Intune need?','How much memory per device does the Intune agent use?','How much data per month can the Graph usage reports return?','How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?'];bad=[q for q in pos if not k.PRICE_ASK.search(q)]+[q for q in neg if k.PRICE_ASK.search(q)];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;p=kbfacts.parse_tag('[CODE S-sipjyeoi: a.go#x; S-gfjnysog, S-aaaaaaaa: b.go#y]');ids=[i for x in p for i in x['ids']];print('ids parsed:',ids);sys.exit(0 if {'S-gfjnysog','S-aaaaaaaa'}<=set(ids) else 1)

clauses.clause: kbfacts.PRICE_ASK matches a 'how much is <product> per user|device|month|year' price ask whose product names storage, capacity, data or RAM (OneDrive storage, Power BI Premium capacity, Sentinel data ingestion) and a multi-line question that asks the cost on a later line ('Context: Intune rollout.' then 'How much does it cost?'), while 'How much memory per device does Intune need?', 'how much data per month' and a Graph resource-unit cost still get no priced note

and kbfacts.parse_tag reads a kind-less part after a semicolon that lists several source ids before its colon (as in [CODE S-a: p#x;S-b, S-c: q#y]) as further sources of the part before it, as it reads a single id there, with lint.py and rag.py eval clean

gates.question: How does PRICE_ASK tell a priced product named by a quantity word from a quantity ask?
options: A quantity word right after how much, or anywhere on the line when no is/are follows how much; a line read alone (re.M)
Drop the quantity exclusion and rely on the cost alternatives
gates.recommendation: A quantity word right after how much, or anywhere on the line when no is/are follows how much; a line read alone (re.M)
gates.answer: A quantity word right after how much, or anywhere on the line when no is/are follows how much; a line read alone (re.M)
